strategy_lines.label: Audience
strategy_lines.text: US employers with 500 to 2,500 employees in healthcare and education, self-insured. Roles: VP HR, Benefits Director, CFO.

strategy_lines.label: Offer
strategy_lines.text: The Benefits Leakage Report, built from the employer's own claims file, showing dollars lost to ineligible dependents. CTA: Send your file.

strategy_lines.label: Message
strategy_lines.text: Cresthaven finds 3% to 5% of self-insured claims spend going to ineligible dependents, and removes them before renewal. Proof: 40 audits in 2026 found an average of 4%.

strategy_lines.label: Channel: LinkedIn ads
strategy_lines.text: LinkedIn ads (paid social), $20,000 at $250 a lead

strategy_lines.label: Tracking
strategy_lines.text: Salesforce campaign CREST-BL-27 on every lead. Opportunities credited to the campaign when it is the primary campaign source.

strategy_lines.label: Funnel
strategy_lines.text: Average deal $40,000, 10% of leads become opportunities in 14 days
